bullets.text: Under course supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, validated SQL joins on provided product review metadata tables using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules with Matplotlib.

As an individual contribution to supervised team research, implemented reusable Python modules for the news summary metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Within supervised team research, validated SQL joins on provided news summary metadata tables using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules with Matplotlib.
